title: Go: Switch Statements
description: Write a Go program that uses a switch statement to determine the day of the week from a number (1-7).

codeTemplate.go:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	day := 3

	switch day {
	case 1:
		fmt.Println("Monday")
	case 2:
		fmt.Println("Tuesday")
	case 3:
		fmt.Println("Wednesday")
	case 4:
		fmt.Println("Thursday")
	case 5:
		fmt.Println("Friday")
	case 6:
		fmt.Println("Saturday")
	case 7:
		fmt.Println("Sunday")
	default:
		fmt.Println("Invalid day")
	}
}

hints: Go's switch doesn't need `break` statements — it breaks automatically
Switch cases can have multiple values: `case 6, 7:`
